name: Eiri Shiina
source:
A third-year who goes to the same school as [url=https://vndb.org/c132897]Tarou[/url] and his friends. She is a childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c132901]Sayataka[/url], who is known for being the worst delinquent at school, and always looks out for him.

[Taken from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/11/10/manimani/]Official Website[/url]]
